facts.value: This is a wide-ranging and flexible degree. In first year, students select four subjects from a total of seventeen on offer. From second year onwards, students select two subjects to continue with for the remainder of their degree.

Bachelor of Arts at UL stands out because it offers unique subject combinations, a built-in work placement (cooperative education) and a mandatory semester of study abroad at one of UL’s partner institutions overseas.
Communication skills to express ideas effectively and persuasively.
Understanding of the forces that shape people, society, culture, communication and the physical world.
